title: Beginner Level 1: Find the Checkmate
explanation: Qxg7 is checkmate. The queen attacks the black king on h8, while the white king on f6 protects the queen on g7.
learning_tip: Board coordinates — When looking for checkmate, examine checks first and then look at every possible escape square.

title: Beginner Level 2: Back-Rank Mate
explanation: Rd8# is a classic back-rank checkmate. The black king is trapped behind its own pawns and has no escape squares.
learning_tip: Piece movement — Always check if your opponent has created an escape square (luft) for their king before committing to a back-rank attack.
